Widget zones place small built-in widgets (stats cards, links, banners) around the page content of a docs site (aiui build, style: docs or custom), configured per template in YAML.
Use the zones property in your template configuration:

Zone Location Notes hero Above the content Banners, announcements leftSidebar Left column Replaces the docs navigation when set rightSidebar Right column Below the table of contents bottomNav Below the content Related links footer Bottom Footer widgets, above the site footer header, topNav, main Accepted by the schema; no layout renders them yet A Toc entry in rightSidebar is skipped: the table of contents is always drawn there when the page has headings. When the config defines a component named sidebar, header or footer and a template leaves the matching zone (leftSidebar, header, footer) empty, the build fills the zone with that component.

Widget Props Progress label, value (0 to 100), showPercent (default true) Announcement title, message, type (info, warning, success) RecentPosts title, posts (list of title, href, date) BadgeList title, badges (list of strings)
Layout Zones rendered FlexibleLayout hero, leftSidebar, rightSidebar, bottomNav, footer ThreeColumnLayout (default) rightSidebar CenteredLayout hero FullWidthLayout hero TwoColumnLayout none
